title: Stop Saying "Very Sad"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very sad". Try one of these instead:
• Miserable: miserable after losing his job
• Heartbroken: heartbroken when her dog died
• Devastated: devastated by the news
• Gloomy: gloomy on a rainy Monday morning
• Down in the dumps: down in the dumps all week

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
